title: xApp RDL — simulações
description: Execução NORI ao vivo, eventos E2 da xApp kpm-probe e vereditos das campanhas (alimentado por scripts/observe/influx_feeder.py).

list.name: run
list.label: Execução
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "simulacoes", tag: "run", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "nori_slice", start: -30d)

target.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "xapp_control" and r._field == "embb_cap_pct")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: "Control " + string(v: r.source) + " eMBB " + string(v: r._value) + " %"}))

panels.title: Execução NORI ao vivo (FlowMonitor, a cada 0,5 s simulado)
Vazão por fatia — execuções recentes

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nori_slice" and r._field == "throughput_mbps")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "slice"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "run", "slice"])

panels.description: Vazão por UE/fatia calculada dos contadores acumulados do FlowMonitor da execução NORI em andamento.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nori_slice" and r._field == "delay_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "slice"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "run", "slice"])

panels.title: Vazão por fatia × tempo simulado — execução escolhida (${run})

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nori_slice" and r.run == "${run}" and (r._field == "throughput_mbps" or r._field == "sim_time_s"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["sim_time_s"], columnKey: ["slice"], valueColumn: "throughput_mbps")
  |> keep(columns: ["sim_time_s", "eMBB", "URLLC"])
  |> sort(columns: ["sim_time_s"])

panels.description: Eixo X: tempo simulado (s). O Control é aplicado pelo NORI no instante de aplicação (docs/07 v5); a queda da fatia restrita aparece alguns segundos simulados depois.

panels.title: xApp kpm-probe (E2: KPM, decisão, RIC Control, ACK)
KPM do nó: PRBs usados e disponíveis

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "xapp_kpm_node" and (r._field == "prb_used_dl" or r._field == "prb_avail_dl"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "xapp_indication" and r._field == "count")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Latência do ACK do RIC Control

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "xapp_control_outcome" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])

panels.title: RIC Control enviados (cotas por fatia, fonte da decisão)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "xapp_control")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "run", "baseline", "source", "order", "embb_cap_pct", "urllc_cap_pct", "pair_gap_ms", "decision_ms"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "certificado" and r._field == "verdict_code")
  |> group(columns: ["gate"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "gate", "_value"])

panels.title: Vereditos de efeito por baseline e regra (todas as execuções NORI)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "campanha_execucao" and r._field == "verdict_code")
  |> group(columns: ["baseline", "rule", "verdict"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["baseline", "rule", "verdict", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "execuções"})
  |> sort(columns: ["rule", "baseline", "verdict"])

panels.title: URLLC antes e depois do Control, por execução (regra v6)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "campanha_execucao" and r.rule == "v6-ratio-apply" and (r._field == "urllc_before_mbps" or r._field == "urllc_after_mbps" or r._field == "urllc_predicted_mbps"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with serie: if r._field == "urllc_before_mbps" then "antes" else if r._field == "urllc_after_mbps" then "depois" else "previsto (v6)"}))
  |> group(columns: ["serie"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "serie"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "simulacoes")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "campanha_execucao")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "run", "rule"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "run", "rule", "verdict", "source", "embb_cap_pct", "urllc_cap_pct", "urllc_before_mbps", "urllc_after_mbps", "urllc_predicted_mbps", "trigger_is_kpm_t0"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 60)
